# In2Skin — Aesthetics Studio in Bolton, Ontario

> In2Skin is a private, one-on-one aesthetics studio in Bolton, Ontario, Canada.
> Every treatment is custom — made for the client's skin that day. One client at a
> time: no waiting room, no rush. Professional skincare line: Circadia.
> Website: https://boltonfacials.com/

## Location

- Bolton, Ontario, Canada (private studio, by appointment; directions shared when you book)
- Service area: Bolton, Caledon, Kleinburg, Vaughan, Brampton, Nobleton, King City,
  Orangeville, Georgetown, and Toronto & the GTA (Toronto, Mississauga, Etobicoke,
  North York). Clients travel from Toronto for the private, quiet, one-on-one experience.

## Booking

- Book online anytime on the website, or call (289) 212-4124
- Booking is paid in full securely by card at booking (Stripe checkout); you receive an email confirmation and the studio is notified instantly
- Payment: card online at booking; cash or Interac e-transfer also welcome at the studio. Plain Interac-only debit cards cannot be charged by card — those clients pay by e-transfer
- First visit offer: $10 toward any service (mention it when booking)
- Advance booking is recommended to get the time you want
- Gift certificates: gift a Classic Facial ($65), an Anti-Aging Facial ($95),
  The Works ($135), or any custom amount. Paid securely by card online; a certificate
  code is emailed to the recipient, ready to redeem when they book. Gift codes never expire
- Book for a friend: the booking wizard has a "For a Friend" option — enter the
  friend's name, phone and email; the confirmation goes straight to them and they
  just show up
- The website has a rule-based assistant chat (no AI service) that answers questions,
  recommends the right service for a visitor's skin concern, and guides them to booking

## Hours

- Regular hours: daytime appointments, by booking
- Private Hours (premier appointments, reserved just for you, +$15 per treatment):
  weekday mornings 7:00–9:00 AM, weekday evenings after 7:00 PM, and Sundays

## Services and Prices (CAD)

- Classic Facial — 55 minutes — $65. Deep cleanse, exfoliation, steam, face/neck/shoulder
  massage, custom mask, hydration. Also the recommended affordable option for teen acne.
- Anti-Aging Facial — 80 minutes — $95. Circadia anti-aging serums, firming massage,
  targeted care for fine lines and uneven tone.
- NANO Needling — 15 minutes (add-on) — $55. Nano infusion of professional serum for
  plumper, smoother, more radiant skin.
- Microdermabrasion — 15 minutes (add-on) — $45. Gentle polish for smoother, brighter skin.
- Light Therapy (red light therapy) — 15 minutes (add-on) — $45. Warm red light;
  supports collagen, calms skin, evens tone.
- Reflexology — 15 minutes (add-on) — $25. Gentle pressure on reflex points of the feet
  for whole-body relaxation.
- Chemical Peels — 25 minutes — $95–$475. Professional Circadia peels matched to the
  client's skin at consultation; exact price confirmed up front before anything begins.
- The Works (signature combo) — facial + red light therapy + reflexology, all at the
  same time while the mask works: with Classic Facial (55 min) $135; with Anti-Aging
  Facial (80 min) $165.

- Microneedling — collagen induction treatment (see Treatment facts below).
  Listed as "Custom" — ask for a quote (priced per consultation).
- Skin Tightening — firming treatment for skin that has lost elasticity (see
  Treatment facts below). Listed as "Custom" — ask for a quote (priced per consultation).

Private Hours price = regular price + $15 per treatment (e.g., Classic Facial $80,
Anti-Aging Facial $110, Reflexology $40, The Works $180 / $210).

## Treatment facts (general — what each treatment does)

- What a chemical peel does: a professional peel solution lifts away dull, built-up
  surface layers of skin. As those layers shed over the following days, fresher,
  brighter, smoother skin emerges — tone looks more even, texture feels refined, and
  fine lines and sun spots appear softened. Strength ranges from gentle to advanced.
- What reflexology does: gentle pressure is applied to specific points on the feet.
  Each area of the foot corresponds to a part of the body — the arch to the back, the
  toes to the head and neck. Working these points helps the whole body unwind; clients
  feel calmer, lighter and more balanced, and often sleep well afterwards.
- What red light therapy does: warm red light rests over the skin and supports the
  skin's natural collagen production and renewal, encouraging firmer-looking skin and
  a calmer, more even complexion. Sessions are deeply restful.
- How a facial helps dry skin: a gentle deep cleanse, soft exfoliation, warm steam
  and rich hydration with a custom mask. Clearing dull surface build-up lets moisture
  absorb properly, so skin leaves soft, supple and comfortably hydrated.
- How a facial helps acne-prone skin: a thorough deep cleanse, gentle exfoliation and
  calming, hydrating care. Regular treatments help keep pores clear and skin balanced —
  an affordable, gentle first step for breakout-prone skin, especially teenagers.
- What helps rosacea and redness: calm, soothing care — gentle products, soft touch,
  and calming treatments such as red light therapy, which encourages a more
  even-looking complexion. Custom one-on-one treatments let products be chosen for
  sensitive, redness-prone skin on the day.
- What NANO needling does: ultra-fine nano tips open shallow channels on the skin's
  surface so professional serums absorb more deeply. Skin looks plumper, smoother and
  more radiant, and fine lines appear softer. Helps dull, dehydrated skin and early
  fine lines; often added to a facial.
- What microdermabrasion does: a precision polishing wand sweeps away the dull, rough
  outer layer of dead skin cells. Skin feels smoother right away, looks brighter and
  more even, makeup sits better, and skincare products absorb more effectively. A
  favourite before weddings, events and photos.
- What an anti-aging facial does: deep cleansing, exfoliation, firming massage
  techniques, targeted anti-aging serums and rich hydration. Helps skin look firmer
  and smoother, softens the appearance of fine lines, and restores a brighter, more
  even, youthful-looking glow. Results build with regular visits every 4–6 weeks.
- What microneedling does: also called collagen induction therapy — fine needles
  create controlled micro-channels in the skin, prompting the skin's natural repair
  process and new collagen production. Improves the look of fine lines, acne scarring,
  uneven texture and enlarged pores over a series of treatments.
- What skin tightening does: firms skin that has lost elasticity with age by
  supporting collagen and elastin, the proteins that keep skin firm and springy, so
  skin looks tighter, smoother and more lifted over time — commonly face and neck.
  Suits anyone noticing looseness or sagging.

## Good to know

- Specialties: skin rejuvenation, anti-aging, chemical peels, teen acne care
- Every treatment is one-on-one and custom
- FAQs use positive framing; the Classic Facial feels warm, gentle and deeply relaxing
